english.notes:
(i) Regulations 5 and 6 provide for powers of constables to require a person to state his name and address.
(ii) Schedule 2 to the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 lists the vehicles that may be used on park roads and the speeds at which they may be driven.
